approval_gate.approval_scope: One small-model run using cloud-run-config.json, up to the spending ceiling; no destructive deletion.
approval_gate.request_text: Please approve the provider, region, model/data/runtime assumptions, spending ceiling, and stop behavior before any paid resource is created.

assumptions.model: The existing 4-layer, 4-head, 64-embedding GPT recipe; exact parameter count depends on the dataset vocabulary.
assumptions.data: data/tinyshakespeare.txt; public teaching fixture; verify license/provenance and SHA-256 before upload.
assumptions.runtime: Python >=3.10, PyTorch >=2.0, provider image records exact CUDA/driver versions; no provider image selected.
assumptions.storage: Checkpoint volume/object storage sized for latest.pt plus step checkpoints and logs; exact size measured during the run.

cost_plan.estimate_method: theoretical GPU hourly rate * planned wall time + storage rate * retained GB-days + provider taxes/fees; replace assumptions with provider quote before approval
cost_plan.stop_behavior: Use a timer and provider-side budget alert where available. Stop/release the compute instance at the ceiling, on failed health checks, or after the planned run. Do not delete retained storage without separate confirmation.
cost_plan.billing_uncertainty: Free quota is not assumed; quota eligibility, billing lag, minimums, taxes, and provider-side hard-cap availability must be confirmed before approval.
cost_plan.storage_charge_follow_up: After compute release, record volume/object identifiers in private notes only and report continuing storage charges; never commit identifiers or secrets.

versioned_inputs.code_revision: record commit SHA immediately before launch
versioned_inputs.environment_lock: record image digest, Python, PyTorch, CUDA, driver, and git SHA in private run log

commands.interrupt_recipe: stop the process after a checkpoint (for example step 200) and preserve the work directory; do not delete latest.pt
commands.resume_recipe: python projects/pretrain/train.py --data-path data/tinyshakespeare.txt --work-dir runs/ticket-19 --device cuda --resume auto --max-iters 1000
commands.independent_eval: python projects/pretrain/evaluate.py --checkpoint runs/ticket-19/latest.pt --data-path data/tinyshakespeare.txt --device cuda --output-json runs/ticket-19/eval_results.json
commands.release: provider-specific stop/release command, copied into the private run log only after approval

evidence.status_note: No provider authorization or paid execution was available for this delivery. No cloud result, GPU identity, elapsed time, metric, or spending value is claimed.

measured_vs_theoretical.interpretation: Local CPU tests validate schema and command shape only; they cannot validate provider billing, GPU throughput, or cloud recovery.

limitations: Actual-run acceptance is unmet until an authorized provider, approval, and real execution record exist.
A provider-side hard cap may not be enforceable; alerts and an operator stop are not guarantees against billing lag.
The config is a prepared recipe, not a cloud result.
